title: Brand guidelines
summary: Turns an idea's problem and audience into a practical brand: positioning, personality, voice and tone with real examples, name and tagline criteria, logo direction, colour and type with reasons, imagery and usage rules, in a short guide.
changes: Borrowed from alirezarezvani brand-guidelines (references/brand-identity-and-framework.md, universal framework section): the voice-attribute table shape (what it means / what it is not), the tone-by-context matrix, the required logo variations (primary, inverted, monochrome, mark-only) and logo usage-rule topics, and the imagery do/don't matrix idea, paraphrased and adapted; the Anthropic-specific identity, print/CMYK, co-branding and presentation rules were not used.
